concept: Kinesis Data Firehose: serverless stream delivery to S3
tests: Choosing a fully managed service for near-real-time loading of streaming data into S3 with format conversion.
expected: Kinesis Data Firehose — buffers and delivers the stream to S3 (Redshift/OpenSearch), built-in JSON → Parquet/ORC conversion, no shards. Triggers: "near-real-time into S3", "no servers or shards", "convert to Parquet".
why_not: Kinesis Data Streams needs your own consumer and shard management; SQS is a queue for decoupling, not delivery to S3; EMR/Spark Streaming is a manually managed cluster.
